nonMatchingValidation.description: venue-native signed test/precheck endpoint that does not create a matching-engine order
examples: venue-native order precheck where explicitly documented non-submitting

realMatchingEngineOrder.reason: current hard test cap is 1 quote unit; fresh local Binance qualification records minNotional=5 USDT for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT

requiredFreshGates: observed account value is within test-account threshold
transfer permission absent where venue exposes it
rules: live endpoint semantics must never be relabeled as Demo or Testnet
user authorization permits qualification use of these live accounts but does not grant production trading
no order may be submitted from user assertion of low balance alone; current authoritative balance evidence is mandatory
test order notional is capped at 1 quote unit unless a later explicit authorization changes it
if venue minimum notional exceeds the cap, the test must stop rather than raise the cap automatically
withdrawal and transfer operations remain forbidden
any ambiguous dispatch is RETAIN and must reconcile before retry
non-matching validation canaries do not imply authorization for a real matching-engine order
